kjv: these sinners against their own souls
mine: these men who sinned at the cost of their lives
note: (KJV 16:38) Hebrew benafshotam, "with/at the price of their lives": the point is that their sin cost them their lives, not that they wronged their own souls.
(KJV 17:10) Hebrew livne-meri, "for sons of rebellion"; the sign is a warning to them, which the KJV makes explicitly adversative; difference is slight.
